from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.options import Options
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
import time

# Chrome path
chrome_path = r"C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"

# Setup Chrome options
chrome_options = Options()
chrome_options.binary_location = chrome_path
chrome_options.add_experimental_option("detach", True)  # Keep browser open

# Use existing Chrome with debugging port
chrome_options.add_argument("--remote-debugging-port=9222")
chrome_options.add_argument("--user-data-dir=C:\\Users\\Administrator\\AppData\\Local\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data")

try:
    # Try to connect to existing Chrome instance
    driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=chrome_options)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")
    print("Trying to launch new Chrome...")
    # If that fails, try launching fresh
    service = Service()
    driver = webdriver.Chrome(service=service, options=chrome_options)

# Navigate to login page
driver.get("https://gez.dongguanbank.cn/landlord/#/login")
print("Navigated to login page")
time.sleep(3)

# Find and fill in username
try:
    username_field = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, "//input[@type='text' or @placeholder='请输入账号']")
    username_field.clear()
    username_field.send_keys("18926879306")
    print("Username entered")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Username field error: {e}")

time.sleep(1)

# Find and fill in password
try:
    password_field = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, "//input[@type='password' or @placeholder='请输入密码']")
    password_field.clear()
    password_field.send_keys("100911yzpYZP")
    print("Password entered")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Password field error: {e}")

time.sleep(1)

# Find and click login button
try:
    login_button = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, "//button[contains(text(),'登录') or contains(text(),'登录')]")
    login_button.click()
    print("Login button clicked")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Login button error: {e}")

# Wait for page to load after login
time.sleep(5)

print(f"Current URL: {driver.current_url}")
print("Browser is open. Please manually navigate if needed.")
